scope: Synthetic namespace admission and one nonprivileged Linux Pod: exact fsGroup 2000, supplementalGroups [3000], writable emptyDir or a case-owned local PVC at /fixture-data, and a read-only synthetic ConfigMap at /protected-data. Inert server dry-runs challenge unsafe group IDs, a forbidden mount path, and hostPath before the sole compliant Pod is created. The case exercises one local persistent-volume mechanism; CSI drivers, external providers, and real platform volumes remain separate. The report's top-level version and image describe the v1.36.1 base cluster. Supplemental Linux disk-backed emptyDir profiles use v1.37.0. Compare matching and mismatched API-server and kubelet feature gates, then verify fsGroup on the enabled node.
